want: to delete a transaction from the feed by swiping it to the left
soThat: I can remove duplicates or transactions that were recorded by mistake
acceptance: swiping a transaction card to the left on the feed reveals a delete affordance
completing the swipe shows a confirmation dialog with the transaction merchant and amount, plus Cancel and Delete buttons
tapping Cancel dismisses the dialog and restores the card to its resting position without changing any data
tapping Delete removes the row from the local cache immediately and issues a DELETE to Supabase against /rest/v1/transactions?id=eq.{id}
if the remote delete fails the row is restored in the local cache and show snackbar with 'Failed to delete transaction. Please try again.' and a Retry button that re-attempts the delete
a successful delete is final (hard delete, not soft)
